events.description: 12. PAPERLESS ORDER Setting Hearing on Motion 8 Amended MOTION for Preliminary Injunction (Emergency Designation), 4 Plaintiff's MOTION for Preliminary Injunction (Emergency Designation). THIS CAUSE is before the Court upon Plaintiff's Amended Emergency Motion for Preliminary Injunction and Incorporated Memorandum of Law (the "Motion") [ECF No. 8], filed on November 6, 2026. It is HEREBY ORDERED AND ADJUDGED that Defendant Alina Garcia shall respond to the Motion [ECF No. 8] no later than November 8, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. PLEASE TAKE NOTICE that a hearing on the Motion is scheduled for November 9, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. in Courtroom 12-3 of the Wilkie D. Ferguson, Jr. U.S. Courthouse, 400 N. Miami Ave., Miami, FL 33128. Counsel of record must appear in person. Motion Hearing set for 11/9/2026 09:00 AM in Miami Division before Judge David S. Leibowitz. Signed by Judge David S. Leibowitz on 11/8/2026. (ewh) (Entered: 11/08/2026)
